My dear [Mary](/person/1626)
[Gertrude](/person/1462) has brightened up this week but she had an embarras de richesses on Wednesday for[ Jane Harper](/person/2360), two children, [Bella Heathcote](/person/1690) [Mrs Buston](/person/236) and [Emily Dampier](/person/404) all came.

She could not see the last two but they are coming on Wednesday afternoon to see her.

We had 104 communicants today - 50 early and 54 late. [Frances](/person/1604) was neuralgic and could not come out so [Maurice](/person/1630) was alone. [George](/person/1610) has grown very tall.

Poor [Caroline Martin](/person/967) died the night before good Friday.
I never had such a scarcity of primroses at Easter!

Your affectionate
C.M.

Yonge
